pyFBS.IO¶

pyFBS.load_uff_file_PAK(uff_file_data, uff_file_output, uff_file_input)[source]¶

Loads an Universal File Format .uff file from PAK system and parses the data in arrays and DataFrames

Parameters

  • uff_file_data (str) – A filename of .uff file containing information on FRFs

  • uff_file_output (str) – A filename of .uff file containing information on channels

  • uff_file_input (str) – A filename of .uff file containing information on reference channels

Returns

frequency vector, FRF matrix, channel DataFrame, impact DataFrame, sensor DataFrame
